Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical data misattribution error in the final analysis step. While the WebSurfer correctly identified that Edwin L. Marin was born in 1899 and Lina Wertmüller was born in 1928, the Planner incorrectly swapped these birth years in its "Updated Understanding" section. It stated "Edwin L. Marin (born 1928)" and "Lina Wertmüller (born 1899)." Consequently, the Planner drew the wrong conclusion that Henry Goes Arizona (1928) had the director born later, whereas the correct answer is The Blue Collar Worker... (1928). This error matches the pattern of misattributing attributes (birth dates) to the wrong entities during the synthesis phase.
